review_candidates.title: OneStream Reporting Specialist Developer, Senior Consultant
review_candidates.description: Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance. Recruiting for this role ends on month 10/02/2026. Work You'll Do As a OneStream Reporting Specialist Developer on the Business Finance team, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining OneStream workforce planning solutions that support budget and finance business processes. Design, develop, and maintain budget and finance business process reporting solutions using the OneStream platform Translate complex business requirements from budget and finance stakeholders into tailored OneStream applications Build and support data integration and automation capabilities that enable effective and user-friendly reporting solutions Provide technical expertise in OneStream extensibility, advanced customization, and complex integrations across the solution environment Mentor developers and resolve escalated technical issues to support solution quality, performance, and delivery A successful candidate would possess these skills: Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team Effective written and verbal communication skills Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others The Team Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise. Our Business Finance offering enables finance to drive strategic value through transformation and synchronization of planning, costing, budgeting and forecasting across finance and other functions. Using advanced, scalable data and tech platforms, we also generate actionable insights and analytics, streamline decision making and enable data driven profitable growth. Manages risk and opportunities associated with diverse and complex grant programs through end-to-end grants management solutions. The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals. Qualifications Required : Bachelor's degree Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future Active Secret clearance 3+ years of experience in similar EPM technology 1+ years of foundational EPM development or configuration experience Preferred: Experience in relevant domains such as budgeting, planning, or federal programs OneStream certification progress Experience with similar EPM platforms that could accelerate the OneStream ramp-up The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,000 to $207,000. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. #GPSFT2026

The successful candidate will be responsible for administering, configuring, and optimizing Jira Product Discovery and Jira Software , while supporting the implementation of effective product discovery processes across the organization. The role will focus on platform administration, workflow configuration, idea management, prioritization, roadmapping, reporting, automation, and integration between product discovery and software delivery. The candidate will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, DevOps, Business Analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure effective adoption and governance of the Atlassian platform. Key Responsibilities1. Jira Product Discovery Administration Configure, administer, and maintain Jira Product Discovery projects. Design and maintain project structures, workflows, statuses, custom fields, and configurations. Configure formulas, scoring models, prioritization frameworks, views, and automation rules. Manage users, roles, permissions, and access controls. Create and maintain standardized templates and configuration standards across product teams. Monitor platform usage and ensure compliance with governance standards. Troubleshoot configuration and access-related issues. 2. Product Discovery & Process Management Design and implement end-to-end product discovery processes within Jira Product Discovery. Configure idea intake, feedback collection, evaluation, and validation processes. Support Product Managers in evaluating, categorizing, and prioritizing ideas. Implement prioritization frameworks and scoring models aligned with business objectives. Establish processes for capturing stakeholder feedback and converting insights into actionable product initiatives. Ensure consistency and governance of product discovery practices across teams. 3. Roadmaps, Dashboards & Reporting Create and maintain product roadmaps using Jira Product Discovery. Configure stakeholder-specific views, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms. Develop executive and operational reports to support decision-making. Provide visibility into product ideas, initiatives, priorities, and delivery progress. Track ideas from initial discovery and prioritization through implementation. Continuously improve dashboards, reports, and stakeholder views. 4. Jira Product Discovery & Jira Software Integration Configure and maintain integrations between Jira Product Discovery and Jira Software. Establish and maintain idea-to-epic traceability . Ensure alignment between product discovery activities and engineering execution. Configure appropriate workflows and linkages between ideas, initiatives, epics, stories, and delivery activities. Support release visibility, delivery tracking, and product lifecycle management. Ensure accurate and consistent data flow between discovery and delivery environments. 5. Governance, Training & Adoption Define and maintain Jira Product Discovery governance standards and operating procedures. Establish scalable administration practices across multiple product teams. Develop user guidelines, process documentation, and best practices. Conduct training sessions and workshops for Product Managers and other stakeholders. Provide ongoing support and guidance to users. Drive adoption and effective utilization of Jira Product Discovery across teams. 6. Process Improvement Analyze existing workflows and identify opportunities for improvement. Optimize Jira configurations, automation, workflows, dashboards, and reporting. Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes through automation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into effective Jira solutions. Stay updated on Atlassian and Jira Product Discovery capabilities and best practices. Required Skills & QualificationsJira & Atlassian Strong hands-on experience with Jira Product Discovery Administration . Strong experience with Jira Software Administration . Experience with Atlassian Cloud Administration . Strong knowledge of Jira workflows, custom fields, screens, schemes, permissions, and project configurations. Hands-on experience with Jira Automation . Experience configuring dashboards, reports, views, and roadmaps. Good understanding of Jira permission schemes, roles, and access controls. Product Management & Agile Good understanding of product discovery methodologies. Experience with product roadmapping and prioritization frameworks. Knowledge of requirements management and stakeholder management. Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and product development lifecycles. Ability to translate business and product requirements into Jira configurations and workflows. Technical Skills Working knowledge of Jira REST APIs . Experience with Atlassian Automation. Basic knowledge of SQL and reporting concepts. Understanding of integrations involving Jira, DevOps, and other enterprise tools. Knowledge of APIs, webhooks, or third-party integrations is an advantage. Soft Skills Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Good process design and documentation skills. Strong attention to detail. Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently in an onsite client environment. Experience 3+ years of experience in Jira Administration. 1+ year of hands-on experience with Jira Product Discovery. Proven experience configuring and administering Atlassian Cloud environments. Experience implementing or optimizing product discovery processes across multiple teams. Experience working with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, and Business teams. Experience in enterprise-scale Atlassian environments is highly desirable. Preferred Certifications Atlassian Certified Professional (ACP) Atlassian Cloud Administration Certification Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) Other relevant Atlassian, Agile, Scrum, or Product Management certifications

review_candidates.description: About the Role We are working with a leading data center developer that is expanding its commissioning team in Salt Lake City, Utah. They are looking for an experienced Commissioning Engineer to support the delivery, testing, and operational readiness of large-scale mission-critical data center facilities. This is a hands-on role suited to an engineer with strong electrical or mechanical commissioning experience who understands the demands of mission-critical environments and can work effectively across contractors, vendors, engineering teams, and clients. Review commissioning documentation, drawings, sequences of operation, test scripts, and equipment schedules. Coordinate with construction, engineering, controls, QA/QC, and commissioning teams to ensure systems are ready for testing. Execute and witness testing of critical MEP systems and identify, troubleshoot, and close deficiencies. Support IST, failover, redundancy, and emergency operating scenario testing. Review equipment startup, installation verification, and pre-functional checklists. Track commissioning progress, deficiencies, test results, and system turnover documentation. Work closely with contractors and vendors to resolve technical issues and ensure systems meet project requirements. Assist with final system acceptance, turnover, and operational readiness. Requirements 3+ years of commissioning experience within data centers, mission-critical facilities, industrial facilities, or similar complex environments. Strong understanding of MEP systems, with a preference for candidates with an electrical or mechanical engineering background. Experience with L1–L5 commissioning and integrated systems testing. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, sequences of operation, and commissioning documentation. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Experience working with general contractors, MEP contractors, vendors, controls teams, and client representatives. Excellent communication and documentation skills. Willingness to work on-site in Salt Lake City, Utah. Desirable Experience Data center or hyperscale commissioning experience. Experience with medium-voltage electrical systems, generators, UPS, switchgear, EPMS/BMS, cooling systems, and controls. Experience with load bank testing, black-building testing, or failure-mode testing. Experience using commissioning management/documentation platforms. Relevant engineering, commissioning, or technical certifications. Why Join? This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing data center developer at a time of significant expansion, working on large-scale mission-critical infrastructure and gaining exposure to complex commissioning and operational readiness programs.
